name: email-best-practices
title_zh: 邮件进垃圾箱前先查这七件事，SPF 到退信重试都管
tagline_zh: 用户收不到验证邮件、退信率飙升、被投诉违反 GDPR 时才想起查 SPF/DKIM/DMARC——它把认证、合规。
tagline_en: When verification emails vanish, bounce rates spike, or GDPR complaints arrive, it turns SPF/DKIM/DMARC.
desc_en: Use when building email features, emails going to spam, high bounce rates, setting up SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, implementing email capture, ensuring compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL), handling webhooks, retry logic, making emails accessible (alt text, headings, contrast, screen readers), or deciding transactional vs marketing.
why_zh: 不是泛泛谈最佳实践，而是按「邮件为什么没到」倒推：先查认证链，再查内容合规，最后才轮到文案。
why_en: It works backwards from why an email failed: authentication first, then compliance, then copy. Not generic advice.
limit_zh: 只覆盖邮件发送侧，不帮你写邮件正文；SPF/DKIM/DMARC 记录要你自己去 DNS 后台加，它只告诉你加什么。
limit_en: Covers sending-side only, not email copy. You still add DNS records yourself; it tells you what to add and how to verify.
title_en: Fix email deliverability before it hits spam
